Definition: an edge or extremity; specifically (of a bird or army) a wing, (of a garment or bedclothing) a flap, (of the earth) a quarter, (of a building) a pinnacle
BiblicalUsage: 1) wing, extremity, edge, winged, border, corner, shirt; 1a) wing; 1b) extremity; 1b1) skirt, corner (of garment)
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
